name: Teresa A. Mcguire

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Samuel A. Powell (1907-1991); Luzerne County marriage record attached on FS

bioAdditions: Daughter of James McGuire and Anna C. Jones; enumerated as Theresa Maguire in her father's Larksville household in 1910. She married Samuel A. Powell in 1934 and died at Nanticoke on 31 Mar 1998, aged 94 (S1).
